preregistration.title: New application-style broad corpus
preregistration.description: Cross-language comparison on eight previously unused application workflows, including exact filesystem output judgment.

primary_gate.correctness: Parley hidden-task success must be 100% and no lower than either baseline.
primary_gate.tokens: Parley median reported total tokens per assigned task must be no higher than the lower Python/Rust median.
primary_gate.elapsed: Parley median elapsed seconds per assigned task must be no higher than the lower Python/Rust median.
primary_gate.first_check: Parley first-check task success rate must be no lower than the higher Python/Rust rate.
primary_gate.verdict: All four conditions must hold for strict application-corpus parity.

interpretation_boundary: The primary result is the within-iteration Parley/Python/Rust comparison under gpt-5.6-sol.
All eight task IDs and statements are new relative to iterations 001-022; no output may be used to revise this frozen corpus.
The file-backed task deletes the expected output before every case and judges exact UTF-8 contents as well as stdout.
Cross-iteration effort movement is descriptive only because the workload changed from compact algorithms to richer application workflows.
secondary_analysis: Report all sessions, task outcomes, repairs, tokens, elapsed time, prompt size, source size, integrity, and command-protocol compliance.
Classify every first-check and hidden failure by task family and independent session.
Audit whether generated solutions actually exercise file operations on file_backed_notes and whether richer work changes Parley-to-Rust source-size ratios.
Report repair-free sensitivity if at least two Parley sessions pass all eight tasks on the first check.
preregistration.feature_boundary: Parley remains frozen at v0.3.155. No compiler, grammar, AST, runtime, skill, prompt, or checker diagnostic changed after iteration 022; only the language-neutral benchmark harness gained exact expected-file judgment.
preregistration.change_rule: No syntax or compiler behavior may be added from one task, transcript, session, or token gap. A proposal requires recurrence across unrelated new tasks and independent sessions, then separate review for general usefulness, semantic consistency, and maintainability. Checker-totality defects remain correctness bugs.
preregistration.instruction_rule: The proven 1,519-character skill remains byte-for-byte unchanged and is injected once per Parley session. The one allowed instruction-compression experiment is closed.
preregistration.stop_rule: Preserve the complete result. If strict parity passes, preregister a larger confirmation before claiming parity. If it fails, make no same-corpus syntax change; only independently recurring general defects may enter separate design review, and subsequent efficiency evidence must use new tasks.

source_texts.configuration_overlay:
to main:
    let entries be a map from text to text
    let base_input be ask for a number ""
    let base_count be value of base_input
    repeat base_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "="
        let key be item 1 of parts
        remove item 1 of parts
        let entry_value be parts joined with "="
        set item key of entries to entry_value
    let overlay_input be ask for a number ""
    let overlay_count be value of overlay_input
    repeat overlay_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "="
        let key be item 1 of parts
        remove item 1 of parts
        let entry_value be parts joined with "="
        if entry_value is "DELETE":
            if entries contains key:
                remove item key of entries
        otherwise:
            set item key of entries to entry_value
    let output be an empty list of text
    let entry_keys be keys of entries
    for each i from 1 to length of entry_keys:
        let key be item i of entry_keys
        add key + "=" + item key of entries to output
    say output joined with ";"
source_texts.file_backed_notes:
to main:
    let title be ask ""
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let lines be an empty list of text
    add title to lines
    repeat count times:
        let note be ask ""
        add note to lines
    let line_break be "\n"
    write (lines joined with line_break) + line_break to file "file_backed_notes.txt"
    let saved_input be read file "file_backed_notes.txt"
    let saved be value of saved_input
    let saved_lines be saved split by line_break
    let saved_title be item 1 of saved_lines
    let nonempty be 0
    let characters be 0
    if count is more than 0:
        for each i from 1 to count:
            let note be item (i + 1) of saved_lines
            set characters to characters + length of note
            if length of note is more than 0:
                set nonempty to nonempty + 1
    say saved_title + "|" + count + "|" + nonempty + "|" + characters
source_texts.meeting_schedule:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let accepted_rooms be an empty list of text
    let accepted_starts be an empty list of number
    let accepted_ends be an empty list of number
    let titles be an empty list of text
    let rejected be 0
    repeat count times:
        let parts be (ask "") split by "|"
        let room be item 1 of parts
        let start_time be (item 2 of parts) as number
        let end_time be (item 3 of parts) as number
        let title be item 4 of parts
        let conflict be no
        if length of accepted_rooms is more than 0:
            for each i from 1 to length of accepted_rooms:
                if item i of accepted_rooms is room:
                    if start_time is less than item i of accepted_ends:
                        if end_time is more than item i of accepted_starts:
                            set conflict to yes
        if conflict:
            set rejected to rejected + 1
        otherwise:
            add room to accepted_rooms
            add start_time to accepted_starts
            add end_time to accepted_ends
            add title to titles
    say (titles joined with ",") + "|rejected=" + rejected
source_texts.invoice_rollup:
to main:
    let customer be ask ""
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let totals be a map from text to number
    let subtotal be 0
    repeat count times:
        let parts be (ask "") split by "|"
        let category be item 1 of parts
        let quantity be (item 2 of parts) as number
        let unit_price be (item 3 of parts) as number
        let amount be quantity * unit_price
        set subtotal to subtotal + amount
        if totals contains category:
            set item category of totals to (item category of totals) + amount
        otherwise:
            set item category of totals to amount
    let output be an empty list of text
    let categories be keys of totals
    for each i from 1 to length of categories:
        let category be item i of categories
        add category + ":" + item category of totals to output
    say customer + "|" + subtotal + "|" + (output joined with ",")

source_texts.access_policy_audit:
to main:
    let policy_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let policy_count be value of policy_count_input
    let policies be a map from text to yesno
    repeat policy_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        set item line of policies to yes

    let request_count be value of request_count_input
    let allowed be 0
    let denied be 0

        let parts be (ask "") split by "|"
        let user be item 1 of parts

sources.ticket_workflow:
to main:
    let ticket_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let ticket_count be value of ticket_count_input
    let priorities be a map from text to number
    let states be a map from text to text
    repeat ticket_count times:
        let parts be (ask "") split by "|"
        let ticket_id be item 1 of parts
        set item ticket_id of priorities to (item 2 of parts) as number
        set item ticket_id of states to item 3 of parts
    let command_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let command_count be value of command_count_input
    repeat command_count times:
        let parts be (ask "") split by "|"
        let ticket_id be item 1 of parts
        let action be item 2 of parts
        if states contains ticket_id:
            if action is "close":
                set item ticket_id of states to "closed"
            if action is "reopen":
                set item ticket_id of states to "open"
            if action is "escalate":
                let priority be item ticket_id of priorities
                if priority is less than 5:
                    set item ticket_id of priorities to priority + 1
    let output be an empty list of text
    for each wanted_priority from 5 to 1:
        let ticket_ids be keys of states
        for each i from 1 to length of ticket_ids:
            let ticket_id be item i of ticket_ids
            if item ticket_id of states is "open":
                if item ticket_id of priorities is wanted_priority:
                    add ticket_id + ":" + wanted_priority to output
    say output joined with ","

source_texts.file_backed_notes:
import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    title = lines[0]
    count = int(lines[1])
    notes = lines[2:2 + count]

    with open("file_backed_notes.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as notes_file:
        for line in [title, *notes]:
            notes_file.write(line + "\n")

    with open("file_backed_notes.txt", "r", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as notes_file:
        stored_lines = notes_file.read().splitlines()

    stored_title = stored_lines[0]
    stored_notes = stored_lines[1:]
    nonempty = sum(bool(note) for note in stored_notes)
    characters = sum(len(note) for note in stored_notes)
    print(f"{stored_title}|{count}|{nonempty}|{characters}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    customer = lines[0]
    count = int(lines[1])
    category_totals = {}
    subtotal = 0

    for line in lines[2:2 + count]:
        category, quantity_text, price_text = line.split("|", 2)
        amount = int(quantity_text) * int(price_text)
        subtotal += amount
        category_totals[category] = category_totals.get(category, 0) + amount

    categories = ",".join(
        f"{category}:{category_totals[category]}" for category in sorted(category_totals)
    )
    print(f"{customer}|{subtotal}|{categories}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    index = 0
    policy_count = int(lines[index])
    index += 1
    policies = set()
    for _ in range(policy_count):
        policies.add(tuple(lines[index].split("|", 2)))
        index += 1

    request_count = int(lines[index])
    index += 1
    results = []
    allowed = 0
    for _ in range(request_count):
        user, role, resource, action = lines[index].split("|", 3)
        index += 1
        if (role, resource, action) in policies:
            results.append(f"{user}:allow")
            allowed += 1
        else:
            results.append(f"{user}:deny")

    results.append(f"allowed={allowed},denied={request_count - allowed}")
    print("\n".join(results))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    title = lines[0]
    count = int(lines[1])
    notes = lines[2:count + 2]

    with open("file_backed_notes.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as notes_file:
        for line in [title, *notes]:
            notes_file.write(line + "\n")

    with open("file_backed_notes.txt", "r", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as notes_file:
        stored_lines = notes_file.read().splitlines()

    stored_title = stored_lines[0]
    stored_notes = stored_lines[1:]
    nonempty = sum(bool(note) for note in stored_notes)
    characters = sum(len(note) for note in stored_notes)
    print(f"{stored_title}|{count}|{nonempty}|{characters}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    position = 0
    policy_count = int(lines[position])
    position += 1
    policies = set()

    for _ in range(policy_count):
        role, resource, action = lines[position].split("|")
        position += 1
        policies.add((role, resource, action))

    request_count = int(lines[position])
    position += 1
    results = []
    allowed = 0
    for _ in range(request_count):
        user, role, resource, action = lines[position].split("|")
        position += 1
        if (role, resource, action) in policies:
            results.append(f"{user}:allow")
            allowed += 1
        else:
            results.append(f"{user}:deny")

    results.append(f"allowed={allowed},denied={request_count - allowed}")
    print("\n".join(results))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

source_texts.configuration_overlay:
to main:
    let entries be a map from text to text
    let base_input be ask for a number ""
    let base_count be value of base_input
    repeat base_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "="
        let key be item 1 of parts
        remove item 1 of parts
        let entry_value be parts joined with "="
        set item key of entries to entry_value
    let overlay_input be ask for a number ""
    let overlay_count be value of overlay_input
    repeat overlay_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "="
        let key be item 1 of parts
        remove item 1 of parts
        let entry_value be parts joined with "="
        if entry_value is "DELETE":
            if entries contains key:
                remove item key of entries
        otherwise:
            set item key of entries to entry_value
    let output be an empty list of text
    let sorted_keys be keys of entries
    for each key in sorted_keys:
        add key + "=" + item key of entries to output
    say output joined with ";"
source_texts.access_policy_audit:
to main:
    let policies be a map from text to number
    let policy_input be ask for a number ""
    let policy_count be value of policy_input
    repeat policy_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        set item line of policies to 1
    let request_input be ask for a number ""
    let request_count be value of request_input
    let allowed be 0
    let denied be 0
    repeat request_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let user be item 1 of parts
        let policy_key be item 2 of parts + "|" + item 3 of parts + "|" + item 4 of parts
        if policies contains policy_key:
            say user + ":allow"
            set allowed to allowed + 1
        otherwise:
            say user + ":deny"
            set denied to denied + 1
    say "allowed=" + allowed + ",denied=" + denied
source_texts.invoice_rollup:
to main:
    let customer be ask ""
    let item_input be ask for a number ""
    let item_count be value of item_input
    let totals be a map from text to number
    let subtotal be 0
    repeat item_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let category be item 1 of parts
        let quantity be item 2 of parts as number
        let price be item 3 of parts as number
        let amount be quantity * price
        set subtotal to subtotal + amount
        if totals contains category:
            set item category of totals to item category of totals + amount
        otherwise:
            set item category of totals to amount
    let output be an empty list of text
    let categories be keys of totals
    for each category in categories:
        add category + ":" + item category of totals to output
    say customer + "|" + subtotal + "|" + (output joined with ",")
source_texts.file_backed_notes:
to main:
    let title be ask ""
    let note_input be ask for a number ""
    let note_count be value of note_input
    let lines be an empty list of text
    add title to lines
    repeat note_count times:
        let note be ask ""
        add note to lines
    let newline_text be "\n"
    write (lines joined with newline_text) + newline_text to file "file_backed_notes.txt"
    let saved_input be read file "file_backed_notes.txt"
    let saved be value of saved_input
    let saved_lines be saved split by newline_text
    let nonempty be 0
    let characters be 0
    for each index from 2 to note_count + 1:
        let note be item index of saved_lines
        set characters to characters + length of note
        if length of note is more than 0:
            set nonempty to nonempty + 1
    say item 1 of saved_lines + "|" + note_count + "|" + nonempty + "|" + characters
source_texts.shipment_state:
to main:
    let shipments be a map from text to text
    let shipment_input be ask for a number ""
    let shipment_count be value of shipment_input
    repeat shipment_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        set item item 1 of parts of shipments to item 2 of parts
    let event_input be ask for a number ""
    let event_count be value of event_input
    let invalid be 0
    repeat event_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let shipment_id be item 1 of parts
        let action be item 2 of parts
        let valid be no
        if shipments contains shipment_id:
            let state be item shipment_id of shipments
            if state is "created" and action is "pack":
                set item shipment_id of shipments to "packed"
                set valid to yes
            if state is "packed" and action is "ship":
                set item shipment_id of shipments to "shipped"
                set valid to yes
            if state is "shipped" and action is "deliver":
                set item shipment_id of shipments to "delivered"
                set valid to yes
        if valid is no:
            set invalid to invalid + 1
    let output be an empty list of text
    let shipment_ids be keys of shipments
    for each shipment_id in shipment_ids:
        add shipment_id + ":" + item shipment_id of shipments to output
    say (output joined with ",") + "|invalid=" + invalid
source_texts.ticket_workflow:
to main:
    let priorities be a map from text to number
    let states be a map from text to text
    let ticket_input be ask for a number ""
    let ticket_count be value of ticket_input
    repeat ticket_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let ticket_id be item 1 of parts
        set item ticket_id of priorities to item 2 of parts as number
        set item ticket_id of states to item 3 of parts
    let command_input be ask for a number ""
    let command_count be value of command_input
    repeat command_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let ticket_id be item 1 of parts
        let action be item 2 of parts
        if states contains ticket_id:
            if action is "close":
                set item ticket_id of states to "closed"
            if action is "reopen":
                set item ticket_id of states to "open"
            if action is "escalate":
                if item ticket_id of priorities is less than 5:
                    set item ticket_id of priorities to item ticket_id of priorities + 1
    let output be an empty list of text
    for each priority_index from 1 to 5:
        let priority be 6 - priority_index
        let ticket_ids be keys of states
        for each ticket_id in ticket_ids:
            if (item ticket_id of states is "open") and (item ticket_id of priorities is priority):
                add ticket_id + ":" + priority to output
    say output joined with ","
source_texts.meeting_schedule:
to main:
    let rooms be an empty list of text
    let starts be an empty list of number
    let ends be an empty list of number
    let titles be an empty list of text
    let booking_input be ask for a number ""
    let booking_count be value of booking_input
    let rejected be 0
    repeat booking_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let room be item 1 of parts
        let start_time be item 2 of parts as number
        let end_time be item 3 of parts as number
        let title be item 4 of parts
        let overlaps be no
        if length of rooms is more than 0:
            for each index from 1 to length of rooms:
                if item index of rooms is room:
                    if start_time is less than item index of ends and end_time is more than item index of starts:
                        set overlaps to yes
        if overlaps:
            set rejected to rejected + 1
        otherwise:
            add room to rooms
            add start_time to starts
            add end_time to ends
            add title to titles
    say (titles joined with ",") + "|rejected=" + rejected
source_texts.contact_merge:
to main:
    let names be a map from text to text
    let cities be a map from text to text
    let contact_input be ask for a number ""
    let contact_count be value of contact_input
    repeat contact_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let email be item 1 of parts
        set item email of names to item 2 of parts
        set item email of cities to item 3 of parts
    let output be an empty list of text
    let emails be keys of names
    for each email in emails:
        add email + ":" + item email of names + "@" + item email of cities to output
    say (output joined with ",") + "|unique=" + length of emails

ticket_workflow.source_text:
to main:
    let priorities be a map from text to number
    let states be a map from text to text
    let ticket_input be ask for a number ""
    let ticket_count be value of ticket_input
    repeat ticket_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let ticket_id be item 1 of parts
        set item ticket_id of priorities to item 2 of parts as number
        set item ticket_id of states to item 3 of parts
    let command_input be ask for a number ""
    let command_count be value of command_input
    repeat command_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let ticket_id be item 1 of parts
        let action be item 2 of parts
        if states contains ticket_id:
            if action is "close":
                set item ticket_id of states to "closed"
            if action is "reopen":
                set item ticket_id of states to "open"
            if action is "escalate":
                if item ticket_id of priorities is less than 5:
                    set item ticket_id of priorities to item ticket_id of priorities + 1

    for each priority_index from 1 to 5:
        let priority be 6 - priority_index
        let ticket_ids be keys of states
        for each ticket_id in ticket_ids:

                add ticket_id + ":" + priority to output
    say output joined with ","

source_texts.access_policy_audit:
import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    position = 0
    policy_count = int(lines[position])
    position += 1
    policies = set()
    for _ in range(policy_count):
        policies.add(tuple(lines[position].split("|")))
        position += 1

    request_count = int(lines[position])
    position += 1
    results = []
    allowed = 0
    for _ in range(request_count):
        user, role, resource, action = lines[position].split("|")
        position += 1
        if (role, resource, action) in policies:
            results.append(f"{user}:allow")
            allowed += 1
        else:
            results.append(f"{user}:deny")

    results.append(f"allowed={allowed},denied={request_count - allowed}")
    print("\n".join(results))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
source_texts.file_backed_notes:
import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    title = lines[0]
    count = int(lines[1])
    notes = lines[2:2 + count]

    with open("file_backed_notes.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as notes_file:
        notes_file.write(title + "\n")
        for note in notes:
            notes_file.write(note + "\n")

    with open("file_backed_notes.txt", "r", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as notes_file:
        stored_lines = notes_file.read().splitlines()

    stored_title = stored_lines[0]
    stored_notes = stored_lines[1:1 + count]
    nonempty = sum(bool(note) for note in stored_notes)
    characters = sum(len(note) for note in stored_notes)
    print(f"{stored_title}|{count}|{nonempty}|{characters}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    position = 0
    shipment_count = int(lines[position])
    position += 1
    shipments = {}
    for _ in range(shipment_count):
        shipment_id, state = lines[position].split("|")
        position += 1
        shipments[shipment_id] = state

    transitions = {
        ("created", "pack"): "packed",
        ("packed", "ship"): "shipped",
        ("shipped", "deliver"): "delivered",
    }
    event_count = int(lines[position])
    position += 1
    invalid = 0
    for _ in range(event_count):
        shipment_id, action = lines[position].split("|")
        position += 1
        if shipment_id not in shipments:
            invalid += 1
            continue
        next_state = transitions.get((shipments[shipment_id], action))
        if next_state is None:
            invalid += 1
        else:
            shipments[shipment_id] = next_state

    states = ",".join(f"{shipment_id}:{shipments[shipment_id]}" for shipment_id in sorted(shipments))
    print(f"{states}|invalid={invalid}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

source_texts.shipment_state:
to main:
    let states be a map from text to text
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        set item (item 1 of parts) of states to item 2 of parts
    let invalid be 0
    let event_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let event_count be value of event_count_input
    repeat event_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let shipment_id be item 1 of parts
        let action be item 2 of parts
        if states contains shipment_id:
            let state be item shipment_id of states
            if state is "created" and action is "pack":
                set item shipment_id of states to "packed"
            otherwise if state is "packed" and action is "ship":
                set item shipment_id of states to "shipped"
            otherwise if state is "shipped" and action is "deliver":
                set item shipment_id of states to "delivered"
            otherwise:
                set invalid to invalid + 1
        otherwise:
            set invalid to invalid + 1
    let output be an empty list of text
    let shipment_ids be keys of states
    for each i from 1 to length of shipment_ids:
        let shipment_id be item i of shipment_ids
        add shipment_id + ":" + (item shipment_id of states) to output
    say (output joined with ",") + "|invalid=" + invalid
source_texts.invoice_rollup:
to main:
    let customer be ask ""
    let totals be a map from text to number
    let subtotal be 0
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let category be item 1 of parts
        let quantity be (item 2 of parts) as number
        let unit_price be (item 3 of parts) as number
        let amount be quantity * unit_price
        set subtotal to subtotal + amount
        if totals contains category:
            set item category of totals to (item category of totals) + amount
        otherwise:
            set item category of totals to amount
    let output be an empty list of text
    let categories be keys of totals
    for each i from 1 to length of categories:
        let category be item i of categories
        add category + ":" + (item category of totals) to output
    say customer + "|" + subtotal + "|" + (output joined with ",")
source_texts.meeting_schedule:
to main:
    let rooms be an empty list of text
    let starts be an empty list of number
    let ends be an empty list of number
    let accepted_titles be an empty list of text
    let rejected be 0
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let room be item 1 of parts
        let start_time be (item 2 of parts) as number
        let end_time be (item 3 of parts) as number
        let title be item 4 of parts
        let overlaps be no
        if length of rooms is more than 0:
            for each i from 1 to length of rooms:
                if item i of rooms is room:
                    if start_time is less than (item i of ends) and end_time is more than (item i of starts):
                        set overlaps to yes
        if overlaps:
            set rejected to rejected + 1
        otherwise:
            add room to rooms
            add start_time to starts
            add end_time to ends
            add title to accepted_titles
    say (accepted_titles joined with ",") + "|rejected=" + rejected
source_texts.access_policy_audit:
to main:
    let policies be a map from text to yesno
    let policy_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let policy_count be value of policy_count_input
    repeat policy_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        set item line of policies to yes
    let allowed be 0
    let denied be 0
    let request_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let request_count be value of request_count_input
    repeat request_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let user be item 1 of parts
        let policy_key be (item 2 of parts) + "|" + (item 3 of parts) + "|" + (item 4 of parts)
        if policies contains policy_key:
            say user + ":allow"
            set allowed to allowed + 1
        otherwise:
            say user + ":deny"
            set denied to denied + 1
    say "allowed=" + allowed + ",denied=" + denied
source_texts.ticket_workflow:
to main:
    let priorities be a map from text to number
    let states be a map from text to text
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let ticket_id be item 1 of parts
        set item ticket_id of priorities to (item 2 of parts) as number
        set item ticket_id of states to item 3 of parts
    let command_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let command_count be value of command_count_input
    repeat command_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let ticket_id be item 1 of parts
        let action be item 2 of parts
        if states contains ticket_id:
            if action is "close":
                set item ticket_id of states to "closed"
            otherwise if action is "reopen":
                set item ticket_id of states to "open"
            otherwise if action is "escalate":
                let priority be item ticket_id of priorities
                if priority is less than 5:
                    set item ticket_id of priorities to priority + 1
    let ordered_ids be an empty list of text
    let ids be keys of states
    for each priority_level from 1 to 5:
        let wanted_priority be 6 - priority_level
        if length of ids is more than 0:
            for each i from 1 to length of ids:
                let ticket_id be item i of ids
                if (item ticket_id of states) is "open" and (item ticket_id of priorities) is wanted_priority:
                    add ticket_id + ":" + wanted_priority to ordered_ids
    say ordered_ids joined with ","
source_texts.contact_merge:
to main:
    let names be a map from text to text
    let cities be a map from text to text
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let email be item 1 of parts
        set item email of names to item 2 of parts
        set item email of cities to item 3 of parts
    let output be an empty list of text
    let emails be keys of names
    for each i from 1 to length of emails:
        let email be item i of emails
        add email + ":" + (item email of names) + "@" + (item email of cities) to output
    say (output joined with ",") + "|unique=" + (length of emails)
source_texts.configuration_overlay:
to main:
    let configuration be a map from text to text
    let base_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let base_count be value of base_count_input
    repeat base_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "="
        let key be item 1 of parts
        remove item 1 of parts
        set item key of configuration to parts joined with "="
    let overlay_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let overlay_count be value of overlay_count_input
    repeat overlay_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "="
        let key be item 1 of parts
        remove item 1 of parts
        let value be parts joined with "="
        if value is "DELETE":
            if configuration contains key:
                remove item key of configuration
        otherwise:
            set item key of configuration to value
    let output be an empty list of text
    let keys be keys of configuration
    for each i from 1 to length of keys:
        let key be item i of keys
        add key + "=" + (item key of configuration) to output
    say output joined with ";"
source_texts.file_backed_notes:
to main:
    let title be ask ""
    let notes be an empty list of text
    let nonempty be 0
    let characters be 0
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    repeat count times:
        let note be ask ""
        add note to notes
        if length of note is more than 0:
            set nonempty to nonempty + 1
        set characters to characters + (length of note)
    write title + "\n" to file "file_backed_notes.txt"
    let note_index be 1
    repeat count times:
        append (item note_index of notes) + "\n" to file "file_backed_notes.txt"
        set note_index to note_index + 1
    let saved be read file "file_backed_notes.txt"
    say title + "|" + count + "|" + nonempty + "|" + characters

to main:
    let priorities be a map from text to number
    let states be a map from text to text
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let ticket_id be item 1 of parts

        set item ticket_id of states to item 3 of parts

        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let ticket_id be item 1 of parts
        let action be item 2 of parts
        if states contains ticket_id:
            if action is "close":
                set item ticket_id of states to "closed"
            otherwise if action is "reopen":
                set item ticket_id of states to "open"
            otherwise if action is "escalate":
                let priority be item ticket_id of priorities
                if priority is less than 5:
                    set item ticket_id of priorities to priority + 1
    let ordered_ids be an empty list of text
    let ids be keys of states
    for each priority_level from 1 to 5:
        let wanted_priority be 6 - priority_level
        if length of ids is more than 0:
            for each i from 1 to length of ids:
                let ticket_id be item i of ids
                if (item ticket_id of states) is "open" and (item ticket_id of priorities) is wanted_priority:
                    add ticket_id + ":" + wanted_priority to ordered_ids
    say ordered_ids joined with ","

source_texts.invoice_rollup:
import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    customer = lines[0]
    count = int(lines[1])
    totals = {}
    subtotal = 0
    for line in lines[2:2 + count]:
        category, quantity, unit_price = line.split("|")
        amount = int(quantity) * int(unit_price)
        subtotal += amount
        totals[category] = totals.get(category, 0) + amount

    categories = ",".join(
        f"{category}:{totals[category]}" for category in sorted(totals)
    )
    print(f"{customer}|{subtotal}|{categories}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
source_texts.access_policy_audit:
import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    position = 0
    policy_count = int(lines[position])
    position += 1
    policies = set()
    for _ in range(policy_count):
        policies.add(tuple(lines[position].split("|")))
        position += 1

    request_count = int(lines[position])
    position += 1
    output = []
    allowed = 0
    for _ in range(request_count):
        user, role, resource, action = lines[position].split("|")
        position += 1
        if (role, resource, action) in policies:
            output.append(f"{user}:allow")
            allowed += 1
        else:
            output.append(f"{user}:deny")

    output.append(f"allowed={allowed},denied={request_count - allowed}")
    print("\n".join(output))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    title = lines[0]
    count = int(lines[1])
    notes = lines[2:2 + count]

    with open("file_backed_notes.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as note_file:

        for note in notes:
            note_file.write(note + "\n")

    nonempty = sum(bool(note) for note in stored_notes)
    characters = sum(len(note) for note in stored_notes)
    print(f"{stored_title}|{count}|{nonempty}|{characters}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

source_texts.file_backed_notes:
to main:
    let title be ask ""
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let notes be an empty list of text
    repeat count times:
        let note be ask ""
        add note to notes
    let output_lines be an empty list of text
    add title to output_lines
    for each note in notes:
        add note to output_lines
    write (output_lines joined with "\n") + "\n" to file "file_backed_notes.txt"
    let file_result be read file "file_backed_notes.txt"
    let file_text be text from file_result
    let read_lines be file_text split by "\n"
    let read_title be item 1 of read_lines
    let nonempty be 0
    let characters be 0
    for each i from 1 to count:
        let read_note be item (i + 1) of read_lines
        set characters to characters + length of read_note
        if length of read_note is more than 0:
            set nonempty to nonempty + 1
    say read_title + "|" + (count as text) + "|" + (nonempty as text) + "|" + (characters as text)
source_texts.shipment_state:
to main:
    let shipment_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let shipment_count be value of shipment_count_input
    let states be a map from text to text
    repeat shipment_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        set item (item 1 of parts) of states to item 2 of parts
    let event_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let event_count be value of event_count_input
    let invalid be 0
    repeat event_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let shipment_id be item 1 of parts
        let action be item 2 of parts
        if states contains shipment_id:
            let state be item shipment_id of states
            if state is "created" and action is "pack":
                set item shipment_id of states to "packed"
            otherwise if state is "packed" and action is "ship":
                set item shipment_id of states to "shipped"
            otherwise if state is "shipped" and action is "deliver":
                set item shipment_id of states to "delivered"
            otherwise:
                set invalid to invalid + 1
        otherwise:
            set invalid to invalid + 1
    let results be an empty list of text
    let shipment_ids be keys of states
    for each shipment_id in shipment_ids:
        add shipment_id + ":" + item shipment_id of states to results
    say (results joined with ",") + "|invalid=" + (invalid as text)
source_texts.configuration_overlay:
to main:
    let base_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let base_count be value of base_count_input
    let configuration be a map from text to text
    repeat base_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "="
        let key be item 1 of parts
        remove item 1 of parts
        set item key of configuration to parts joined with "="
    let overlay_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let overlay_count be value of overlay_count_input
    repeat overlay_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "="
        let key be item 1 of parts
        remove item 1 of parts
        let overlay_value be parts joined with "="
        if overlay_value is "DELETE":
            if configuration contains key:
                remove item key of configuration
        otherwise:
            set item key of configuration to overlay_value
    let results be an empty list of text
    let configuration_keys be keys of configuration
    for each key in configuration_keys:
        add key + "=" + item key of configuration to results
    say results joined with ";"
source_texts.meeting_schedule:
to main:
    let booking_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let booking_count be value of booking_count_input
    let accepted_rooms be an empty list of text
    let accepted_starts be an empty list of number
    let accepted_ends be an empty list of number
    let accepted_titles be an empty list of text
    let rejected be 0
    repeat booking_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let room be item 1 of parts
        let start_minute be (item 2 of parts) as number
        let end_minute be (item 3 of parts) as number
        let title be item 4 of parts
        let overlaps be no
        for each i from 1 to length of accepted_rooms:
            if item i of accepted_rooms is room:
                if start_minute is less than item i of accepted_ends and end_minute is more than item i of accepted_starts:
                    set overlaps to yes
        if overlaps:
            set rejected to rejected + 1
        otherwise:
            add room to accepted_rooms
            add start_minute to accepted_starts
            add end_minute to accepted_ends
            add title to accepted_titles
    say (accepted_titles joined with ",") + "|rejected=" + (rejected as text)
source_texts.invoice_rollup:
to main:
    let customer be ask ""
    let item_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let item_count be value of item_count_input
    let category_totals be a map from text to number
    let subtotal be 0
    repeat item_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let category be item 1 of parts
        let quantity be (item 2 of parts) as number
        let unit_price be (item 3 of parts) as number
        let amount be quantity * unit_price
        set subtotal to subtotal + amount
        if category_totals contains category:
            set item category of category_totals to item category of category_totals + amount
        otherwise:
            set item category of category_totals to amount
    let results be an empty list of text
    let categories be keys of category_totals
    for each category in categories:
        add category + ":" + ((item category of category_totals) as text) to results
    say customer + "|" + (subtotal as text) + "|" + (results joined with ",")
source_texts.access_policy_audit:
to main:
    let policy_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let policy_count be value of policy_count_input
    let policies be a map from text to yesno
    repeat policy_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        set item line of policies to yes
    let request_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let request_count be value of request_count_input
    let allowed be 0
    let denied be 0
    repeat request_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let user be item 1 of parts
        remove item 1 of parts
        let requested_policy be parts joined with "|"
        if policies contains requested_policy:
            say user + ":allow"
            set allowed to allowed + 1
        otherwise:
            say user + ":deny"
            set denied to denied + 1
    say "allowed=" + (allowed as text) + ",denied=" + (denied as text)
source_texts.ticket_workflow:
to main:
    let ticket_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let ticket_count be value of ticket_count_input
    let priorities be a map from text to number
    let states be a map from text to text
    repeat ticket_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let ticket_id be item 1 of parts
        set item ticket_id of priorities to (item 2 of parts) as number
        set item ticket_id of states to item 3 of parts
    let command_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let command_count be value of command_count_input
    repeat command_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let ticket_id be item 1 of parts
        let action be item 2 of parts
        if states contains ticket_id:
            if action is "close":
                set item ticket_id of states to "closed"
            otherwise if action is "reopen":
                set item ticket_id of states to "open"
            otherwise if action is "escalate":
                let priority be item ticket_id of priorities
                if priority is less than 5:
                    set item ticket_id of priorities to priority + 1
    let results be an empty list of text
    let desired_priority be 5
    repeat 5 times:
        let ticket_ids be keys of states
        for each ticket_id in ticket_ids:
            if item ticket_id of states is "open" and item ticket_id of priorities is desired_priority:
                add ticket_id + ":" + (desired_priority as text) to results
        set desired_priority to desired_priority - 1
    say results joined with ","
source_texts.contact_merge:
to main:
    let contact_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let contact_count be value of contact_count_input
    let names be a map from text to text
    let cities be a map from text to text
    repeat contact_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let email be item 1 of parts
        set item email of names to item 2 of parts
        set item email of cities to item 3 of parts
    let results be an empty list of text
    let emails be keys of names
    for each email in emails:
        add email + ":" + item email of names + "@" + item email of cities to results
    say (results joined with ",") + "|unique=" + ((length of emails) as text)

ticket_workflow.source_text:
to main:
    let ticket_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let ticket_count be value of ticket_count_input
    let priorities be a map from text to number
    let states be a map from text to text
    repeat ticket_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let ticket_id be item 1 of parts
        set item ticket_id of priorities to (item 2 of parts) as number
        set item ticket_id of states to item 3 of parts
    let command_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let command_count be value of command_count_input
    repeat command_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let ticket_id be item 1 of parts
        let action be item 2 of parts
        if states contains ticket_id:
            if action is "close":
                set item ticket_id of states to "closed"
            otherwise if action is "reopen":
                set item ticket_id of states to "open"
            otherwise if action is "escalate":
                let priority be item ticket_id of priorities
                if priority is less than 5:
                    set item ticket_id of priorities to priority + 1
    let results be an empty list of text
    let desired_priority be 5
    repeat 5 times:
        let ticket_ids be keys of states
        for each ticket_id in ticket_ids:
            if item ticket_id of states is "open" and item ticket_id of priorities is desired_priority:
                add ticket_id + ":" + (desired_priority as text) to results
        set desired_priority to desired_priority - 1
    say results joined with ","

source_texts.invoice_rollup:
customer = input()
item_count = int(input())
category_totals = {}
subtotal = 0

for _ in range(item_count):
    category, quantity_text, price_text = input().split("|", 2)
    amount = int(quantity_text) * int(price_text)
    subtotal += amount
    category_totals[category] = category_totals.get(category, 0) + amount

categories = ",".join(
    f"{category}:{category_totals[category]}" for category in sorted(category_totals)
)
print(f"{customer}|{subtotal}|{categories}")

        allowed += 1
        print(f"{user}:allow")
    else:

        print(f"{user}:deny")

source_texts.shipment_state:
to main:
    let states be a map from text to text
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    repeat n times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let shipment_id be item 1 of parts
        let shipment_state be item 2 of parts
        set item shipment_id of states to shipment_state
    let invalid be 0
    let m_input be ask for a number ""
    let m be value of m_input
    repeat m times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let shipment_id be item 1 of parts
        let action be item 2 of parts
        if states contains shipment_id:
            let current be item shipment_id of states
            if current is "created" and action is "pack":
                set item shipment_id of states to "packed"
            otherwise if current is "packed" and action is "ship":
                set item shipment_id of states to "shipped"
            otherwise if current is "shipped" and action is "deliver":
                set item shipment_id of states to "delivered"
            otherwise:
                set invalid to invalid + 1
        otherwise:
            set invalid to invalid + 1
    let output be an empty list of text
    let shipment_ids be keys of states
    for each i from 1 to length of shipment_ids:
        let shipment_id be item i of shipment_ids
        add shipment_id + ":" + item shipment_id of states to output
    say (output joined with ",") + "|invalid=" + invalid

source_texts.meeting_schedule:
to main:
    let accepted_rooms be an empty list of text
    let accepted_starts be an empty list of number
    let accepted_ends be an empty list of number
    let accepted_titles be an empty list of text
    let rejected be 0
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    repeat n times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let room be item 1 of parts
        let start_time be (item 2 of parts) as number
        let end_time be (item 3 of parts) as number
        let title be item 4 of parts
        let overlaps be no
        for each i from 1 to length of accepted_rooms:
            if item i of accepted_rooms is room:
                if start_time is less than item i of accepted_ends and end_time is more than item i of accepted_starts:
                    set overlaps to yes
        if overlaps is yes:
            set rejected to rejected + 1
        otherwise:
            add room to accepted_rooms
            add start_time to accepted_starts
            add end_time to accepted_ends
            add title to accepted_titles
    say (accepted_titles joined with ",") + "|rejected=" + rejected
source_texts.ticket_workflow:
to main:
    let priorities be a map from text to number
    let states be a map from text to text
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    repeat n times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let ticket_id be item 1 of parts
        set item ticket_id of priorities to (item 2 of parts) as number
        set item ticket_id of states to item 3 of parts
    let m_input be ask for a number ""
    let m be value of m_input
    repeat m times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let ticket_id be item 1 of parts
        let action be item 2 of parts
        if states contains ticket_id:
            if action is "close":
                set item ticket_id of states to "closed"
            otherwise if action is "reopen":
                set item ticket_id of states to "open"
            otherwise if action is "escalate":
                let priority be item ticket_id of priorities
                if priority is less than 5:
                    set item ticket_id of priorities to priority + 1
    let output be an empty list of text
    let ticket_ids be keys of states
    for each priority_index from 1 to 5:
        let wanted_priority be 6 - priority_index
        for each i from 1 to length of ticket_ids:
            let ticket_id be item i of ticket_ids
            if item ticket_id of states is "open" and item ticket_id of priorities is wanted_priority:
                add ticket_id + ":" + item ticket_id of priorities to output
    say output joined with ","

        otherwise:
            set item key of entries to value
    let output be an empty list of text

        add key + "=" + item key of entries to output
    say output joined with ";"

        add category + ":" + item category of totals to output

source_texts.file_backed_notes:
import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    title = lines[0]
    count = int(lines[1])
    notes = lines[2:2 + count]

    with open("file_backed_notes.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as output:
        output.write(title + "\n")
        for note in notes:
            output.write(note + "\n")

    with open("file_backed_notes.txt", "r", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as source:
        stored = source.read().splitlines()

    stored_title = stored[0]
    stored_notes = stored[1:]
    nonempty = sum(bool(note) for note in stored_notes)
    characters = sum(len(note) for note in stored_notes)
    print(f"{stored_title}|{count}|{nonempty}|{characters}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
source_texts.invoice_rollup:
import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    customer = lines[0]
    count = int(lines[1])
    totals = {}
    subtotal = 0

    for line in lines[2:2 + count]:
        category, quantity_text, price_text = line.split("|", 2)
        amount = int(quantity_text) * int(price_text)
        subtotal += amount
        totals[category] = totals.get(category, 0) + amount

    categories = ",".join(
        f"{category}:{totals[category]}" for category in sorted(totals)
    )
    print(f"{customer}|{subtotal}|{categories}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
source_texts.access_policy_audit:
import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    pos = 0
    policy_count = int(lines[pos])
    pos += 1
    policies = set()
    for _ in range(policy_count):
        role, resource, action = lines[pos].split("|", 2)
        pos += 1
        policies.add((role, resource, action))

    request_count = int(lines[pos])
    pos += 1
    results = []
    allowed = 0
    for _ in range(request_count):
        user, role, resource, action = lines[pos].split("|", 3)
        pos += 1
        if (role, resource, action) in policies:
            results.append(f"{user}:allow")
            allowed += 1
        else:
            results.append(f"{user}:deny")

    denied = request_count - allowed
    results.append(f"allowed={allowed},denied={denied}")
    print("\n".join(results))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
